new_value: Fixed in rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs. The misleading debug_assert ('cannot demote a root' while the table allows Root->Unjoined) is gone. adopt_version() now returns Result<(), InvalidDodagTransition> and rejects BEFORE mutating anything when role==Root, encoding the real invariant (roots mint versions, never adopt one) as a runtime error on all build profiles. process_dio() propagates Err as DioOutcome::Rejected. For non-root roles the subsequent set_role(Unjoined) is infallible per the transition table and documented as such. Covered indirectly via public API: root_ignores_newer_version_dio asserts version unchanged + still Root after newer-version DIO.
